crossRefs.note: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes round, and Sarah will have…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”
“I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
Salvation belongs to Yahweh. May your blessing be on your people.
God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
“Behold, I am Yahweh, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?
Yahweh of Armies says: “If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be…
Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”
For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
translations.bsb: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
translations.kjv: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
translations.asv: And Jesus looking upon them said to them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
